title: product-image upload request headers
description: PROPOSAL product-images §4.1: the headers of PUT /api/v1/sync/product-images/{productId}, written as a JSON object (header name => value). The body is the picture's bytes exactly as hashed: no JSON, no multipart, no Content-Encoding. Every §3 sync header is sent as on sync/push (Authorization, X-SSPOS-Company-Id, X-SSPOS-Branch-Id, X-SSPOS-Register-Id, X-SSPOS-Contract, X-SSPOS-App-Version, optional X-SSPOS-Store-Protocol); no Idempotency-Key (the picture's SHA-256 is the idempotency key).

Authorization.description: The branch's sync key, as on every sync/* call (never in the address).

Content-Type.description: Must be the type of the bytes (the portal reads the type from the bytes and refuses a mismatch with 415 image.unsupported_type).

Content-Length.description: The number of bytes sent. At most 2097152 (2 MB); larger → 413 image.too_large before the body is read.

X-SSPOS-Image-Sha256.description: SHA-256 of exactly the bytes in the body, lower-case hex. Same value as the picture the portal holds → 200 unchanged, nothing stored. Not the hash of the body → 422 image.hash_mismatch.

X-SSPOS-Image-Source.description: Optional (IMG-2, till 0.1.83): where the till got the picture. own = the shop chose it; library = Open Food Facts by barcode (CC BY-SA, credited on the public store); found = a web image search (copyright unknown); unknown = a picture from before the till sent this header. The public online store shows own and library by default, found and unknown only when the shop turns on "Show found pictures". The portal never refuses an upload over this header: missing, empty or any other value is stored as unknown (trimmed, any case). On a 200 unchanged upload a different known value (own, library, found) updates only the origin held; unknown never overwrites a known one.
